# criblio_monitor_profile (Resource)

MonitorProfile Resource

Groups shared configurations in order and optionally links to a parent profile. Referenced configurations and parents must exist. Cribl enforces tree uniqueness and a maximum hierarchy depth of four.

Changes replace the profile because the backend PATCH path does not rebuild hierarchy metadata. Delete or unlink referencing monitors and child profiles before replacement or deletion. For Terraform-managed dependants, coordinate their replacement explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "criblio_monitor_profile" "my_monitor_profile" {
  config_ids = []
  id = "my-profile"
  name = "Production Monitors"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tools/codegen -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config_ids` (List of String) Ordered list of shared configuration IDs attached to this profile.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the profile.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the profile.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description of the profile.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent profile ID. Undefined for root profiles.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = criblio_monitor_profile.my_criblio_monitor_profile
  id = "example"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import criblio_monitor_profile.example platform-profile
```
